shellCommands.command:
PORT=3010 npm start &
SERVER_PID=$!
sleep 1

echo "=== GET / ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/home.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3010/
echo "title from home:"
grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/home.html

echo
echo "=== GET /books/new ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/new.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3010/books/new

echo
echo "=== POST /books (create a book) ==="
curl -sS -i -X POST -d 'title=Deep+Work&author=Cal+Newport' http://localhost:3010/books | head -5

echo
echo "=== GET /books (list should show it) ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:3010/ | grep -o 'href="/books/[a-f0-9]\{8\}"' | head -5

echo
echo "=== POST /books/:id/finish ==="
NEW_ID=$(curl -sS http://localhost:3010/ | grep -oE '/books/[a-f0-9]{8}' | grep -v 'finish' | head -1 | cut -d'/' -f3)
echo "Book id: $NEW_ID"
curl -sS -i -X POST http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID/finish | head -3

echo
echo "=== GET /books/:id after finish (should say Finished on) ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID | grep -oE 'Finished on [^<]+|Currently reading'

echo
echo "=== POST /books/:id/notes ==="
curl -sS -i -X POST -d 'notes=Brilliant+book.' http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID/notes | head -3
echo
echo "=== GET /books/:id notes block ==="
curl -sS http://localhost:3010/books/$NEW_ID | grep -A0 'Brilliant book\.'

echo
echo "=== GET unknown id ==="
curl -sS -o /tmp/nf.html -w "status=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3010/books/deadbeef
grep -oE 'Not found|That book' /tmp/nf.html | head -2

kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null
wait 2>/dev/null
echo "done"
